mentions.name: fabric
mentions.description: A local-first app that lets you review markdown, answer Q&As, and review code with your agents, now with an accompanying CLI. The builder uses it in their own workflow and is still fixing bugs; possible monetization via a cloud sync feature is being considered.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on https://fabric.shivan.dev/ - its a local-first app which lets you review markdown, answer Q&As and review code with your agents. Still working out a few bugs as I use it in my workflow. Also added a CLI.
